Definition: from G1909 and G4685; to draw over, i.e. (with G203 implied) efface the mark of circumcision (by recovering with the foreskin):--become uncircumcised.
BiblicalUsage: Epispaomai means to draw over, to efface the mark of circumcision — and Paul says, Is any man called being circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised, and let the uncircumcised man not seek circumcision.
TheologicalSignificance: The outward mark is not the matter, I believe: keeping the commandments of God is.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
